reasoning: Shows two right-angled arrows forming a cycle inside a filled rounded square, universally recognized as repeat/loop, repost/retweet, sync, or swap. While it is also a media-player repeat-mode toggle, it maps cleanly to action-centric tasks where syncing, reposting, exchanging, or swapping is the main point, though it competes closely with unboxed repeat or curved sync icons.

pass1.ambiguity: Closely overlaps with unboxed repeat/loop arrows, curved refresh/sync icons, and swap/exchange arrows; in task lists it looks like a task-recurrence status badge rather than a task topic.

distinguishing: Shows two right-angled arrows pointing in opposite directions to form a closed rectangular loop (repeat, repost, or cycle), whereas the crossing-arrows icon shows two diagonal arrows intersecting and both pointing right (shuffle or randomize).
